# SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1 Selector-Resolution and Data-Independence Amendment

Record identity: `SCI-FLT-FIXED-SELECTOR-RESOLUTION-AMENDMENT v0.1/draft-r0.4`

Status: implementation-blind Stage B closure artifact; scientific-owner review required

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Stage B date: `2026-08-31`

Normative authority remains the shared normative core. Plan independence and
parent-fact selector resolution are distinct.

Parent payload amplitudes do not select, learn, tune, or alter coefficients,
cutoff or width, normalization, transfer qualification, edge method, support
rule, thresholds, or another plan fact. No amplitude-thresholded,
source-sensitive, spectral-selection, or other data-derived method is
admitted.

`J_full` is resolved once from only declared immutable parent identity and row
membership, exact parent-row admission, typed availability, typed finiteness,
support, and exact required predicates. Inspecting an authorized required
payload solely to classify its declared finite or non-finite state is
structural screening, not convolution arithmetic and not permission to tune
the plan.

Response, covariance, NOI members, and every other compatible companion reuse
the same resolved `J_full`; none re-resolves it from its own values.
